t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are 6 gnomes - brown, red and pink gnomes are associated with the red basket and green, blue and yellow gnomes are associated with the yellow basket. pick one colour basket and keep selecting gnomes that are associated with that colour basket. keep doing this until you see a decrease in the number of mushrooms and where there's too much of a decrease, switch to the other basket colour.

vb_textbox.text: There are 6 different colour gnomes, and all correspond with one of two basket colours; either red or yellow basket. The red, purple and pink gnomes correspond with the red basket, and the yellow, blue and orange gnomes correspond with the yellow basket. Choose one basket colour to start with, and keep selecting gnomes that correpond with that colour basket until there's a consistent decrease in the number of mushrooms. Once there's too much of a decrease, switch to the other basket colour.
